proposal.summary: Certain Lexmark devices (such as CS310) before 2023-08-25 allow XML External Entity (XXE) attacks that lead to information disclosure. Fixed in firmware level P246 (LW80.*.P246 or later).
proposal.cwe_quote: allow XXE attacks, leading to information disclosure.

AV.quote: Certain Lexmark devices (such as CS310) before 2023-08-25 allow XXE attacks

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain vendor advisory or firmware changelog to confirm affected models, exact attack vector (network endpoint or local), and scope of data disclosed; apply firmware LW80.*.P246 or later as recommended.

evidence_quotes.quote: allow XXE attacks, leading to information disclosure.
Certain Lexmark devices (such as CS310) before 2023-08-25

The fixed firmware version is LW80.*.P246, i.e., '*' indicates that the full version specification varies across product model family, but firmware level P246 (or higher) is required to remediate the vulnerability.
